desc: Ask [C10]: How is my gym progress going?

body.question: How is my gym progress going?

response:
{"id":13,"answer":"Your saved notes contain only one gym entry, so there isn't enough logged history to describe a trend or say whether you're progressing over time.

What that single entry (your most recent gym log) records:
- Squats: 5x5 at 80kg — you noted it felt heavy.
- Bench: 3x8 at 55kg.
- Left shoulder: slightly tight on the last set of the session.

So the picture from your notes is: a solid working set on squats at 80kg that felt like a grind, bench volume at 55kg, and a minor shoulder tightness worth watching. There's no second session logged to compare weights, reps, or how the shoulder felt afterward, so no progression (or regression) can be inferred.

If you want a real progress summary, it would help to log each session with date, exercise, sets/reps/weight, and any niggles — and to note your shoulder over the next few sessions to see whether the tightness is a one-off or a pattern.","references":{"coverage":"partial","general_knowledge":false,"explanation":"Only one note (id 10) in the saved notes is a gym log entry; everything else is unrelated (Java/DSA study, finance, groceries, sleep, DeepNotes project feedback, book notes).
